lines: /tmp is shadowed by a later mount on /tmp
after:shadow.why: GhostBSD's own installer does it on every ZFS install: pc-sysinstall's setup_fstab (backend/functions-cleanup.sh) always appends 'tmpfs /tmp tmpfs rw,mode=1777' to fstab, and Install Station's zfs_datasets (install_station/data.py, make-ghostbsd.sh's ZFS_DATASETS) has a zroot/tmp dataset at /tmp, which the zfs rc script mounts over fstab's tmpfs at every boot; harmless, the tmpfs under it stays empty, and the UFS guest has the tmpfs alone (GuestTest2 t2v-20261117T1944-5b0f, the before and after hooks on Cage, 2026-11-17)

image:sources.why: Kali is Debian testing rebuilt as kali-rolling: its one apt source is http.kali.org/kali kali-rolling (kali.sources, deb822, written by kali.postinst), which carries the security fixes too; there is no -security suite to point at, as on pikaos4 (docs/design/kali.md, What K1 found)

image:free.why: ostree: / is the composefs overlay, a read-only EROFS image that df always shows 100% full; the physical root's btrfs shows at /etc and /var (docs/design/bazzite.md, What B7 found)

after:boot-state.why: systemd-remount-fs fails at every boot on ostree (below), so the system is degraded (bazzite.md, What B1 found)

after:failed-units.why: it remounts / with fstab's options and the composefs overlay refuses ("No changes allowed in reconfigure"); every boot, the Thinkpad's fstab the same (bazzite.md, What B1 found)

after:fstab.why: Anaconda's ostree fstab lists /home (a link to var/home) before /var; findmnt resolves the link, systemd orders the mounts itself, and HoltTest1 sees the same on source and restore (bazzite.md, What B6 found)

image:free.why: openSUSE's MicroOS VM image (make-opensuse.sh microos) has a 20 MiB ESP, 16 MiB free, holding only shim and GRUB: GRUB loads the kernel and initrd from the btrfs root's /boot inside the snapshot (grub.cfg's linux /boot/vmlinuz-*), so a kernel update never writes to the ESP and the 200 MiB floor for kernel-holding ESPs doesn't apply; image:free's 90% full line still guards it (GuestTest2 t2v-20261117T1944-5b0f, the before hook on Chopin, 2026-11-17)

after:boot-state.why: make-omnios.sh's first boot ends with svcadm disable cloud-init:initlocal (testvm/omnios/user-data): later boots have no CIDATA disk, and searching for one stalls the boot.  cloud-init's init, modules and final stages require initlocal, so SMF holds them offline at every boot, by design; multi-user and console-login want cloud-init:final only optionally

lines: /dev/pts is shadowed by a later mount on /dev/pts
after:shadow.why: a second devpts is mounted over /dev/pts late in each boot of the stock guest (the boot's own devpts, then fstab's devpts line again; the cause not traced further), both guests alike; harmless, as both are the same devpts options (docs/design/slackware.md S4: the before hook on Chopin, 2026-11-15)

lines: findmnt: [E] cannot detect on-disk filesystem type
after:fstab.why: Slackware's stock fstab keeps setup's /dev/fd0 /mnt/floppy auto noauto line; the guest has no floppy, so findmnt --verify can't detect that source's file system. Every boot, before and after an update alike (docs/design/slackware.md S4: the before hook on Chopin, 2026-11-15)
